h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gulbarga

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gulbarga

items.pText: Gulbarga, now officially Kalaburagi, lies on the dry Deccan plateau in north Karnataka. Summers are long and very hot, and water is precious for much of the year. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, colleges, housing layouts and public gardens in the city from our factory in Vasai, about 470 km away, delivered by road.

Many buyers picture a playground on green grass and then find that the lawn needs daily watering through April and May. Under swings and at the foot of slides, grass also wears into bare, hard patches within a season. So in Gulbarga we usually plan a play area that needs almost no water to keep in good shape. Send us photos of your site and the age group of the children, and we will work out the layout with you.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A play area that does not depend on watering

c: Rubber flooring under the equipment gives a cushioned, even surface with no watering at all. It also stays usable after the monsoon showers, when bare soil turns slippery. Keep grass or hardy plants for the edges, where children do not land. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts suit the dry heat, and a shade tree or structure over the slides keeps them comfortable past mid-morning.

items.q: Is grass a good surface under playground equipment in Gulbarga?
items.a: Grass needs regular watering in this climate and wears thin under swings and slide exits. Rubber flooring needs no water, cushions falls and stays level, so we suggest it for the main play zone.

items.q: Do slides get too hot in a Gulbarga summer?
items.a: Any slide left in full sun warms up by late morning. Roto-moulded slides stay cooler than bare metal, and placing them in shade or facing north keeps them comfortable for longer.

items.q: Do you deliver to north Karnataka?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Gulbarga and nearby towns by road, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it on a self-standing or grouted base.
